limitations: Native output/ability-family dispatch is bounded to simulator hit receipts and attack IDs. Equal native random branch weights are mapped to independent seeded draws; nested event order is recorded and tested, not claimed frame-identical.
Native forward Sniper postfilter21 is mapped to the immediately-forward tile then nearest eligible Sniper in the source attack range, with deploy sequence as a deterministic tie break.

Native Sequence casts are mapped to immediate independent recipient/self buffs; the source beginning clip is presentation without additional damage, skill/SP holds or interrupts. The ending clip is retained as evidence but is not yet played.
No modules, original Unity particles or audio.
